name: Osgood-Schlatter Disease
definition: Traction apophysitis of the tibial tubercle in skeletally immature adolescents, commonly associated with running and jumping sports.

typical: Anterior knee pain at tibial tubercle

investigations.radiographs: Radiographs when atypical or fracture is suspected.

amber: Symptoms are usually self-limited with skeletal maturity; surgery is rarely needed.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Janu/Asthi-Snayu growth-related phenotype may be documented.

patientEducation.summary: Traction apophysitis of the tibial tubercle in skeletally immature adolescents, commonly associated with running and jumping sports.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise, locked joint or other listed red flags.
